state.query: Search for the original uploader and earliest dated copy of the specific video, using reverse video/keyframe search and archive records, to establish its provenance and first publication date.

candidates.title: How to Reverse Search a Video and Find Its Original Source ...
candidates.snippet: Learn how to reverse search a video using keyframes, screenshots, search engines, timestamps, and source tracing to find its original source and context.

candidates.title: How to Verify a Video in 2026: Provenance, Frames, Deepfakes
candidates.snippet: How to verify a video step by step in 2026: C2PA Content Credentials, SynthID and Sora watermarks, InVID keyframes, metadata, forensics and a 12-step workflow.

candidates.title: How to find the original source of a photo or video
candidates.snippet: Preserve the copy and its page context, search the whole image plus distinctive crops or video keyframes, then build a dated candidate timeline. Follow credits and links backward until they reach a creator or attributable publication. Report the result as a confirmed creator publication, earliest public copy located, likely source, or unresolved, because the oldest indexed result is not ...

candidates.title: Who Posted This Video First? Find the Original Uploader
candidates.snippet: Find who posted a video first: search its frames to find every copy, compare upload dates and open the earliest one. Works with TikTok and YouTube links. Free.

candidates.title: Reverse Video Search: Upload a Clip or Paste a URL
candidates.snippet: Upload a video, paste a public URL, or search by keywords to find matching pages and investigate original video sources with Reverse Video Search.
